title: Relationship Relief on Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Hold Rates
content:
**Relationship relief on the hold rate — Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Clause.** The hold rate relationship relief is 10 percentage points (the full relationship relief) when the customer holds an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract or an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract that shows days past due of 0; it is 5 percentage points (the partial relationship relief) when the customer holds no such contract but holds an active Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract that shows days past due of 0; and it is nothing otherwise. The relief is subtracted from the hold rate before the rate is applied.

**Which contract is read.** Where the customer's records for one of these products list more than one active contract, the first active contract listed for that product is the one read.

| Active new-vehicle retail contract (first listed) | Active balloon contract (first listed) | Active pre-owned retail contract (first listed) | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 days past due | — | — | 10 points |
| 15 days past due | 0 days past due | — | 10 points |
| 15 days past due | none | 0 days past due | 5 points |
| none | none | 0 days past due | 5 points |
| none | none | 8 days past due | nothing |
| none | none | none | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a hold rate of 35 percent for a customer with a current Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract becomes 25 percent before it is applied to the balance.
